item.title: Commentary: Public health requires communiy action
item.description: While it will always be wise to ensure you are giving informed consent to medical decisions, the purpose of the HHS is to provide evidence-based recommendations that the scientific community at large agrees to be the most beneficial for public health. In its current state, the HHS is not carrying out this function. This unfortunately means that a burden has been placed on those with the ability to more carefully think through their medical decisions, no matter how small or seemingly unimportant.

item.title: From the editors: Our apology and vow to develop more extensive editorial policies around covering protests
item.description: In our Feb. 5 issue, The Ithacan wrongly identified a protester in the photo caption. When we wrongly identified this person, we failed to meet our mission to thoughtfully report for our community's best interests, and our commitment to minimize harm. We are deeply sorry for this error and will use this as an opportunity to reflect on our editorial practices and processes. item.title: Editorial: Bad Bunny and the Big Game – The influential power of art and sports
item.description: It is hard to say that the NFL was entirely making a political statement by choosing Bad Bunny for the halftime show. It equally and realistically could have been functioning as a business, strategically attempting to grow viewership as well as increase publicity. But what is clear is the impact and influential power the NFL, as well as sports in general, has on culture as well as politics in the United States.
